title: Allocator-war denominator closure fan-out Wave 25
purpose: Convert every explicit unavailable obligation retained by Wave 24 into a deterministic packet-owned closure queue, require institutional-gate identification before downstream work in gate-unspecified packets, and preserve zero evidence adjudication, finding promotion, graph effect, or publication authority.

gate_identification_keywords: specific legislative or political-finance institutional gate

gate_identification.required_output: Bounded institutional-gate identification packet with named selector, decision instrument, affected rows, consequence, correction route, source custody, and an explicit no-gate result when the search remains negative.
gate_identification.closure_test: A source-addressed institutional decision surface is identified with selector, bounded window, affected rows, consequence, and correction route, or the bounded search terminates explicitly with no qualifying gate identified.

denominator_closure.required_output: Complete denominator ledger with included, excluded, rejected, ineligible, withdrawn, failed, unavailable, null, appealed, and corrected rows for the bounded gate.
denominator_closure.closure_test: Every row in the declared option or affected universe has a source-addressed disposition, and no unavailable or excluded row is silently converted into a null.

instrument_rights_recovery.required_output: Operative instrument-and-rights ledger containing executed agreements, criteria, custody, schedules, interfaces, exceptions, review rights, termination, substitution, and public-recovery terms.
instrument_rights_recovery.closure_test: The operative instrument, decision custody, rights and obligations, exceptions, review routes, and exit or recovery terms are source-addressed and reversible.

entity_resolution.required_output: Exact legal-entity crosswalk with source names, aliases, registration identifiers, temporal validity, unresolved variants, and prohibited joins.
entity_resolution.closure_test: Every admitted cross-system join resolves to the same legal entity within the bounded period, and every unresolved or conflicting variant remains blocked.

outcome_correction_recovery.required_output: Longitudinal consequence-and-correction ledger with selection, nonselection, performance, failure, substitution, appeal, remedy, recurrence, exit, recovery, and no-observed-effect controls.
outcome_correction_recovery.closure_test: The bounded outcome window includes supportive, contradictory, failed, substituted, appealed, corrected, recovered, and explicit no-observed-effect rows with dated provenance.
